title: Milestone 1: council MVP
purpose: A working AI council the Prime can question, watch and steer.
change: Bounded deliberation pipeline, five provider adapters plus labelled demo, live chamber with SSE, Prime controls, spending guard, replay timeline, security baseline.
validation: Unit tests (orchestration, failures, cancellation, spend, adapters, reducer), real-PostgreSQL integration test, Playwright desktop + mobile e2e, lint, typecheck, build.
remainingIssues: Real-model calls not exercised (no API keys in the build environment); adapters are tested against local HTTP stubs.

title: Milestone 2: persistent intelligence
purpose: Let the council remember what the Prime approves and propose discussions, without autonomy by default.
change: Memory screen with review-before-use imports, suggested discussions with reasons, opt-in bounded background scheduler with global pause.
validation: Unit tests for import safety, suggestion rules and every scheduler gate; Playwright memory flow.
remainingIssues: Background sessions run only while the app server is running.

title: Milestone 3: living society
purpose: Grow the council into a small simulated community whose large decisions go to the council.
change: Deterministic world engine with a closed fictional economy, projects, growth and guilds; council docket linked to sessions; snapshots, restore, replay; animated map.
validation: Determinism, purity, credit conservation, non-negativity, snapshot replay and society-milestone tests; Playwright world flow.
remainingIssues: Inhabitant behaviour is rule-based only; model-written dialogue is not implemented.

title: Milestone 4: continuous improvement
purpose: Make daily, bounded, reviewable improvement possible once the repository is connected.
change: CI workflow, daily improvement workflow (off until enabled), auto-merge with base-branch eligibility rules and a branch-protection check, local cron script, setup script, this history page.
validation: Eligibility unit tests and CLI dry-runs; workflow YAML parsed. The workflows themselves have not run yet because the GitHub repository does not exist.
remainingIssues: Scheduling is inactive: needs the GitHub repo, secrets, branch protection and DAILY_IMPROVEMENT_ENABLED=true.

title: Prime Council: Founder, Primes and Chronicle
purpose: Reshape the product around the Founder's vision: one Prime per AI model building intelligence and a simulated world for truth and human benefit, with the Founder seeing only major decisions and outcomes.
change: Rename to Prime Council; Founder role; editable charter in every Prime's context; Primes seeded across configured model families; Chronicle home with outcome tiles; opt-in Prime governance of world decisions; agents record their creating Prime; bounded relationship state; autonomous deliberations collapsed by default.
validation: Unit + PostgreSQL integration tests (94), Playwright desktop + mobile e2e (14), lint, typecheck, build.
remainingIssues: Agents at very large scale need cohort simulation and sharded storage; Primes cannot yet propose new world rules.

title: Link world decision sessions back to the world
purpose: When the Founder opens a session the Primes held about a world decision, there was no way back to the decision itself.
change: Sessions linked to a world decision show a 'Back to the world's decisions' link in their header.
validation: lint, typecheck, unit tests, build; Playwright world flow extended to follow the link.
remainingIssues: The link goes to the world page, not to the specific project (projects have no anchor yet).

title: Beyond the System: the council questions the system it works within
purpose: Let every Prime question the framing, objective and rules of its task — distinguishing fundamental constraints from inherited conventions — and keep what the council learns so it can build on it later, including about itself.
change: BeyondTheSystem lens for every seat; an exploration mode (system map, alternatives, attack, experiment design, learning) inside the bounded pipeline; code checks with no novelty score; a discoveries table with search, linking, revisits and Founder-recorded experiment results; opt-in recursive self-examination whose proposals are approval-gated records.
validation: Unit tests for assumption identification, alternatives, disagreement, parsing, persistence and safe execution; Playwright flow for the mode and the discovery record; lint, typecheck, build in CI.
remainingIssues: Model judgement is only evaluated by the opt-in real-model eval (npm run eval:beyond), not yet run; near-duplicate and linking detection is lexical.
